name: East Group Co.,Ltd
summary: East Group Co.,Ltd engages in the research, development, production, and sales of UPS power supplies, data centers, photovoltaic product integration, new energy vehicle charging piles, energy storage, and other products in China and internationally. The company offers line interactive, online transformerless, online transformer-based, modular, low voltage, and LiFePO4/sodium-ion UPS product, as well as accessories, such as batteries and UPSmart monitoring software. It also provides modular data centers, electric vehicle charging piles, and sodium ion batteries.
